address: 167-169 Wardour Street, Soho, London, W1F 8WR, United Kingdom
bio: Walk down Wardour Street and you’ll find yourself being drawn to this Indian restaurant by the warm and inviting glow it emits. A more relaxed sister to Tamarind in Mayfair, this elegant spot is run by an endearingly willing team and the atmosphere is always equally infectious. The menu traverses India and offers something for everyone, from an excellent biryani to a creamy lobster Malabar curry. Equal care goes into the cocktails; the 'Passion Chilli Sour' will brighten any day....
